nominal.situation:
All robots nominal; gas at background on both decks (2% LEL), acoustic flat.
go2-2 patrolling deck B; go2-3 docked and charging.
No action needed.

actions.rationale: Gas and ultrasonic baselines are flat; continue the deck B patrol loop.

repair.situation:
go2-1 is treating rust patch R-1 on deck A; detector confident, brush force inside the 40 N limit.
Deck B gas flat at 2% LEL; go2-2 on patrol, go2-3 charging at the dock.
Keep go2-3 docked as the backup verifier.

actions.rationale: Repair is proceeding inside force and soak limits with no competing hazard.
Battery under 80%: hold on the dock until a second-view task needs it.

leak_suspect.situation:
Probable flange leak at F3 (deck B): gas and ultrasonic dB rising together for ~20 s.
Plume estimate under 1 kg/h methane, drifting west; deck A is upwind and unaffected.
Send go2-2 to check F3 bolts; second view from go2-3.

actions.rationale: Nearest robot; the gas and acoustic co-rise localises the source to the F3 flange.
An independent upwind view separates a loose bolt from a gasket failure.
A leak above 10% LEL needs the control room to check hot-work permits on deck B.

anomalies.note: Gas %LEL and ultrasonic dB rising together at one flange.

evacuate.situation:
Gas at F3 jumped past 50% LEL with a step in dB and plume flow: likely gasket blowout.
Edge rules pulled go2-2 upwind and evacuated deck B.
Isolate the F3 line from the control room; robots stay out until gas is under 10% LEL.

actions.rationale: Above 50% LEL needs human isolation of the line; a robot cannot fix a blowout.
Plume covers the deck B walkway; keep people and robots out.
Keep the backup robot off deck B until the gas falls.
Re-torquing the loose bolts would stop the leak at the source.

anomalies.note: Step change in gas, dB and plume flow at once, not a slow seep.

recovering.situation:
F3 line isolated by the crew; gas falling fast and ultrasonic back near baseline.
Storm building on deck B: gusts on the exposed walkway.
Re-check F3 once gas is under 5% LEL; deck A repair carries on.

actions.rationale: Wait for gas under 5% LEL and calmer gusts before re-entering deck B.
Deck A stayed upwind of the F3 plume throughout.
Freshest battery; verify the F3 bolts once the gas has cleared.

anomalies.note: Storm level rising while a robot waits on the exposed deck.

force_spike.situation:
go2-1 hit a force spike on patch R-1; the edge layer backed it off.
Sharp force step while most rust remains: likely a weld bead or pitting under the brush.
Take a close-up before resuming at reduced press.

actions.rationale: A close-up shows whether the spike was a weld bead or a pit before scrubbing on.
Retry at 0.7x press once the view confirms no crack.

anomalies.note: Force spike with most rust still present: weld bead or pitting under the brush.

person.situation:
Worker inside 3 m of go2-1 on deck A; the edge layer paused the arm.
Repair R-1 resumes by itself once the worker is past 3 m.
Other robots unaffected.

actions.rationale: Keep the arm parked until the person is more than 3 m away.
Remind the deck A crew of the 3 m exclusion zone around active repair.

anomalies.note: Person inside the 3 m zone during active repair.

verifier_dispute.situation:
go2-1 detector says the patch is clean but Gemini-ER still sees rust residue.
Painting over rust is the failure to prevent, so trust the stricter verdict.
F3 gas back to background; storm easing.

actions.rationale: Run one more scrub cycle before paint; the verifier sees orange residue.
A second angle resolves glare-driven disagreement between the two checks.

anomalies.note: On-board detector under 5% rust vs Gemini-ER rust verdict.

storm.situation:
Storm level high: gusts and spray across the decks, camera views degrading.
Work under cover can continue; exposed patrols should wait.
Edge gas, force and person rules stay in force.

actions.rationale: Gusts on the exposed deck raise slip and false-detection risk.
Repair site is sheltered and force stays in limits.

anomalies.note: Storm level high during exposed outdoor work.

done.situation:
Repair R-1 complete: rust 0%, paint 100%, confirmed by detector and Gemini-ER.
F3 isolated and gas back to background; storm easing.
Send go2-3 to re-check F3 bolts; go2-1 back to patrol.

actions.rationale: Freshest battery; the F3 flange needs a post-isolation bolt check.
Repair verified; return to the deck A patrol loop.
Gas clear and gusts easing; resume the deck B patrol.
